review_candidates.description: Job Description: Senior Network Engineer Location: Atlanta, GA Work Arrangement: Onsite Number of Positions: 2 Job Summary This role requires both hands-on technical depth and the ability to contribute to long-term infrastructure strategy in a fast-moving semiconductor company. The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for the design, implementation, and operational excellence of Semtech's global network infrastructure, spanning 30+ sites across North America, EMEA, and APAC. This role owns a broad technology portfolio including Palo Alto next-generation firewalls, Zscaler, Aryaka SD-WAN, LAN/WAN architecture, Cisco L2/L3 network devices, and cloud networking across AWS and Azure environments. The first major initiative for this role will be leading Semtech's migration from its current firewall infrastructure to a Zscaler-based zero-trust architecture. Beyond that project, the role will continue to own the design, operation, and improvement of the global network, along with initiatives such as VPN modernization and cross-regional connectivity. Working closely with the IT Infrastructure, Security, and Cloud teams, this role plays a key part in ensuring network resilience, performance, and security for a fast-growing global semiconductor company. Responsibilities Design and Architecture: Plan and build scalable, reliable physical and wireless network infrastructures, including Local Area Networks (LANs), Wide Area Networks (WANs), and cloud connectivity. (8%) Configuration and Deployment: Install, configure, and manage core networking hardware and services such as routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, DNS, and DHCP. (25%) Monitoring and Optimization: Observe network performance metrics, analyze traffic patterns, and perform system tuning to maximize efficiency and prevent downtime. (15%) Troubleshooting and Incident Response: Diagnose and resolve complex network outages, performance degradation, and connectivity faults across multi-vendor environments. (25%) Security Management: Implement network security controls, access policies, firewalls, and VPNs to protect corporate assets against cyber threats. (12%) Planning and Documentation: Maintain detailed architecture diagrams, manage compliance with change control processes, and evaluate emerging technologies. (15%) Education and Experience 8 years of information technology experience. 3+ years of experience in a dedicated network engineering role. Hands-on experience with Palo Alto firewalls and routing. Hands-on experience with Cisco switches. Hands-on experience with Zscaler. Bachelor's degree or technical school training in Computer Science, Network Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. Network architecture experience preferred. Qualifications Advanced knowledge of networking principles and practices. Comprehensive understanding of routing protocols, switching technologies, and network security. Expert proficiency with network management tools, monitoring systems, and security platforms. Meticulous attention to detail and accuracy in network design and implementation. Excellent organizational and time management skills. Superior written and verbal communication abilities. Advanced problem-solving capabilities with a systematic approach. Expert understanding of network security, compliance, and risk management. Demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate effectively across functions. Commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing. Comprehensive understanding of semiconductor industry network requirements. Advanced ability to analyze complex network issues and develop solutions. Experience with network automation and software-defined networking. Knowledge of cloud networking and hybrid connectivity models. Professional certification in networking (CCNP, PCNSE, Zscaler, etc.) preferred.
